subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Belly of the Whale
description: One-minute skill: The Belly of the Whale.

hook.text: Jonah spent three days inside a whale. Pinocchio was swallowed by a giant fish. The belly is a womb.

buildup.text: After crossing the threshold, the hero is consumed by the unknown—swallowed by the adventure itself.

discovery.text: The belly of the whale represents total separation from the old world. Isolation forces inner change.

twist.text: It's not punishment—it's incubation. The hero enters darkness to be reborn. Death leads to renewal.

climax.text: Emerging from the belly means the hero has died symbolically and been reborn as someone new.

punchline.text: Sometimes you have to be swallowed to grow.

quiz.question: What does the 'belly of the whale' symbolize?
